# Rejuvenate Skin Spa

> Rejuvenate Skin Spa is a boutique, non-surgical skincare studio in Queen Creek, Arizona, founded by licensed cosmetologist Bridgette Ball. The studio offers Plexr plasma skin tightening, microneedling, chemical peels, enzyme facials, and spa services to clients throughout the Phoenix East Valley, including Queen Creek, San Tan Valley, Chandler, Gilbert, and Mesa.

Note: Every page on this site has a plain-Markdown mirror for AI and LLM consumption. Append .md to the end of any page URL to retrieve the Markdown version (e.g. https://www.rejuvenateskinspa.com/about-us.md). The homepage is the one exception: its Markdown mirror resolves at either https://www.rejuvenateskinspa.com/.md or https://www.rejuvenateskinspa.com/index.md (both return the same content).

## Plasma Treatments
- [Plexr Plasma Skin Tightening](https://www.rejuvenateskinspa.com/plexr-plasma-skin-tightening): Hub page for non-surgical plasma pen skin tightening across three intensity levels.
- [Ablative Skin Resurfacing](https://www.rejuvenateskinspa.com/plexr-plasma-skin-tightening/ablative-skin-resurfacing): Highest-intensity Plexr plasma resurfacing.
- [Semi-Ablative Skin Resurfacing](https://www.rejuvenateskinspa.com/plexr-plasma-skin-tightening/semi-ablative-skin-resurfacing): Moderate-intensity Plexr plasma resurfacing.
- [Nano-Ablative Skin Resurfacing](https://www.rejuvenateskinspa.com/plexr-plasma-skin-tightening/nano-ablative-skin-resurfacing): Lightest-intensity Plexr plasma resurfacing with minimal downtime.
- [Mole Removal](https://www.rejuvenateskinspa.com/plexr-plasma-skin-tightening/mole-removal-treatment): Non-surgical mole removal via Plexr plasma.
- [Skin Tag Removal](https://www.rejuvenateskinspa.com/plexr-plasma-skin-tightening/skin-tag-removal-treatment): Non-surgical skin tag removal via Plexr plasma.
- [Sun Spot Removal](https://www.rejuvenateskinspa.com/plexr-plasma-skin-tightening/sun-spot-removal-treatment): Non-surgical sun spot / age spot removal.
- [Wart Removal](https://www.rejuvenateskinspa.com/plexr-plasma-skin-tightening/wart-removal-treatment): Non-surgical wart removal via Plexr plasma.

## Microneedling
- [Microneedling](https://www.rejuvenateskinspa.com/microneedling): Hub page for collagen induction therapy options.
- [Traditional Microneedling](https://www.rejuvenateskinspa.com/microneedling/traditional-microneedling): Standard microneedling for texture and tone.
- [SQT Bio Microneedling](https://www.rejuvenateskinspa.com/microneedling/sqt-bio-microneedling): Microneedling enhanced with SQT Bio serum.
- [Plasma Microneedling](https://www.rejuvenateskinspa.com/microneedling/plasma-microneedling): Microneedling combined with plasma technology.

## Chemical Peels
- [Chemical Peels](https://www.rejuvenateskinspa.com/chemical-peels): Hub page for professional-grade chemical peels.

- [BioRePeel 35 TCA Facial Peel](https://www.rejuvenateskinspa.com/chemical-peels/biorepeel-facial-peels): Facial-strength BioRePeel TCA formulation.
- [BioRePeel 50 TCA Body Peel](https://www.rejuvenateskinspa.com/chemical-peels/biorepeel-body-peels): Body-strength BioRePeel TCA formulation.
- [TCA Peels](https://www.rejuvenateskinspa.com/chemical-peels/tca-peels): Trichloroacetic acid medium-depth peels.
- [Glycolic Acid Peels](https://www.rejuvenateskinspa.com/chemical-peels/glycolic-acid-peels): AHA-based exfoliating peels.
